Commitment domains are optional arrays; DomainImpact requires 1-4 registered action/domain pairs. Action UID 0 is valid, action existence/domain is checked through ActionRegistry, and claim supersession uses a commitment-keyed companion index rather than an unavailable arbitrary entity scan.

G$ commitment rewards derive source/beneficiary/token/amount from the Fulfilled commitment. Funding is limited to ProtocolToGarden. Reports persist reportedBy; only the active Chainlink Functions callback can produce Verified or receipt-invalid Failed, and infrastructure errors leave Reported for retry. Pilot Safe recovery is exactly 2-of-3 (protocol multisig, Dev Guild recovery multisig, named garden delegate); executors are scoped Roles members and never owners.
